manual_steps: Prepare and verify the Osmo 360 MP4 twin using Spatial Film OSV Converter.
Apply Spatial Film or Gyroflow and verify motion/lens data.
Assign the licensed Action 6 input LUT exactly once.
Build and verify grading nodes and the final PQ output CST. Project declarations do not transform pixels.
Set LUT interpolation to Tetrahedral and verify project/monitor LUT slots are empty.
Configure monitoring and export settings; verify render and HDR metadata.
note: Foundation only: empty timeline and media pool imports. Mixed 59.94/29.97 sources are retained at native rates; timeline is 29.97. No grade, output CST, OFX, render, proxy, or Cloud setup is automated.
